title: F&O
description: Equity F&O home: P&L, indices, chart metrics, watchlists, Smart Options, Futures Heatmap and Smart Futures.

screens.name: Equity home
screens.note: From the main F&O tab. Home returns to Stocks; DASH, Search, Profile and Wallet open their existing flows. Selectors, chart metrics, filters, sorting and watchlist creation work locally. Destinations outside this frame open an explanatory sheet.

screens.name: Home · watchlists & Smart Options
screens.note: The same long screen, scrolled to watchlists.

screens.name: Scalper
screens.note: From ScalpPro on F&O home or the Scalper bottom-nav tab. The chart-tools sheet groups personal DASH AI indicators separately from Lemon indicators.

screens.name: Scalper · DASH indicator
screens.note: From DASH AI’s View indicator. Opens the chart-tools sheet directly on Indicators, the saved DASH AI indicator under Your indicators with a focus guide. Tap rows to add / remove indicators (several at once); search filters the list.

screens.name: Scalper · indicator applied
screens.note: With the saved DASH AI indicator on the chart: “1 ▾” at the chart’s top-left and illustrative EMA 9 / 21 lines on the NIFTY 50 candles.

screens.name: Commodities home
screens.note: The Commodities product tab. Gold / Silver / Crude Oil / Natural Gas shortcuts open the Lot summary (Gold Summary). The chart’s instrument selector (“Gold”) opens the contract picker. Popular commodities: Options ⇕ Futures switch; Futures Heatmap: Bullion / Energy / Metals.

screens.name: Commodities · heatmap & Smart Futures
screens.note: The same long screen, scrolled to the Futures Heatmap.

screens.name: Contract picker · Commodities
screens.note: From the chart’s “Gold ⇕”. Equity / Commodities tabs in the sheet header’s bottom slot, commodity chips (All, Gold, Silver …) under them; contracts grouped by commodity as radio rows (Gold Mini tagged “Lowest Margin”). Picking one updates the chart and closes the sheet.

screens.name: Contract picker · Equity
screens.note: The same sheet on its Equity tab: the 8 index contracts.

screens.name: Gold Summary · by price
screens.note: From a commodity shortcut on fno-08. Gold lot tabs (Gold, Gold Mini, Gold Guinea, Gold Ten, Gold Petal) in the Actionbar’s bottom slot; Futures (View all) and Options (View option chain, expiry month, category pills, Filter, sort). The sort opens a sheet: By Price · By Volume · Margin per lot.

screens.name: Gold Summary · by volume
screens.note: Sorted by volume: each option shows its traded volume, no change.

screens.name: Gold Summary · margin per lot
screens.note: Sorted by margin per lot: each option shows the margin for one lot, no change.

screens.name: Strategies · Equity
screens.note: The Strategies product tab with Equity selected in the pill group: shortcuts, Zing Trades, Smart Invest, Pre-build Strategies (Nifty 50 ⇕, Bullish / Bearish / Neutral / Volatile), Quick Trade. Card footer buttons stay Small (32) as in Figma.

screens.name: Strategies · Commodities
screens.note: The same tab with Commodities selected: commodity Smart Invest baskets, GOLD as the underlying.

screens.name: Option chain
screens.note: From Option chain on the F&O chart (any product tab) or the Option Chain bottom-nav tab; Back → F&O home. Opens scrolled to the spot pill. BankNifty ▾ and Expiry ▾ open sheets; Σ shows delta instead of the day change; the basket and Zing tile open the explanatory sheet. Column heads: Call / Put metric (LTP, OI, OI Chg, IV) and the strike range (All, ±5, ±10). Tap a price to Buy, tap it again to Sell, a third time to clear.

screens.name: Option chain · Buy selected
screens.note: A put price tapped once: B badge, green wash, the order dock with the contract, Balance / Req, quantity in lots and Buy (brand). Buy places a sample order (toast) and clears the selection.

screens.name: Option chain · Sell selected
screens.note: The same put tapped again: S badge, red wash, Sell (secondary) in the dock; Req becomes the margin per lot.

screens.name: Option chain · illiquid contract
screens.note: Illiquid contracts (deep in-the-money calls, far out-of-the-money puts) carry a block icon beside the price, like Groww. Unlike Groww, a tap never selects them: a tooltip opens just above — “ILLIQUID contract” / “Can’t be traded” ⓘ; tapping away closes it, ⓘ opens a sheet with why it’s blocked, its traded lots and buy–sell gap, and a tip. Opens on the 25,700 put with the tooltip up.

screens.name: Asset page · Gold MINI
screens.note: A commodity contract page. Entry (one of several): the contract name in the option chain order dock (“25,400 Put ›”). Back returns where it came from; Option chain → fno-17; Buy / Sell open the sample sheet. Equity contracts get their own (similar) page later.

screens.name: Asset page · illiquid
screens.note: Product rule (commodities only): an illiquid contract’s page shows the ILLIQUID tag next to its name and Buy / Sell greyed out, with “Trading is not allowed as this contract is illiquid” above them — whatever screen it was opened from.

screens.name: Gold Summary · Buy / Sell sheet
screens.note: Tapping any futures or option card opens the Buy / Sell sheet (live app, 2026-10-29): name › (asset page fno-21) · price, expiry · change, Buy (brand) / Sell (secondary).

screens.name: Gold Summary · illiquid sheet
screens.note: Product rule (commodities): an illiquid contract carries the ILLIQUID tag on its card (edge case — illiquid contracts shouldn’t be listed, but the state is built) and in the sheet; Buy / Sell are greyed out with “Trading is not allowed as this contract is illiquid”. Only the name › (asset page fno-22) or tapping outside works.

screens.name: Order pad · Buy · Market
screens.note: Commodity option chain order pad (other order pads differ a little). From Buy on the commodity asset page or the Gold Summary Buy / Sell sheet. Delivery / Intraday tabs, Market / Limit / SL pills, Quantity (⇕ lots) in steps of one lot, Set TPSL, Avail. · Req, Buy. Placing shows a sample toast; no order is sent.

screens.name: Order pad · Buy · Limit
screens.note: Limit adds the validity (Day ⇕ → Day / IOC) and a limit price row with a % stepper from the market price.

screens.name: Order pad · Buy · SL
screens.note: SL adds a trigger price row above the limit row.

screens.name: Order pad · Buy · Intraday
screens.note: Intraday: “This position will auto close by 11:30 PM” above the dock.

screens.name: Order pad · Sell · Market
screens.note: Sell adds Margin · Leverage (grey strip) above the quantity; the action is Sell (red).

screens.name: Order pad · Buy · ILLIQUID (edge case)
screens.note: Should never be reached — every entry point blocks illiquid contracts — but if one slips through: ILLIQUID tag in the header (tap → “What does illiquidity mean?”), the blocked note in the dock (tap → same sheet) and Buy disabled. Inputs stay usable.

screens.name: Order pad · Sell · ILLIQUID (edge case)
screens.note: The same edge case on the Sell side: Sell disabled.
